description: Source code for the MainActivity class of an Android Tic Tac Toe app, responsible for UI initialization, event handling, and rendering game state.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity managing the UI for the Tic Tac Toe game, including displaying the board, handling user input, and updating visuals based on game state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and wiring of event listeners, also subscribes to game state updates.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI elements based on the current game state, including board cells, status message, scores, and restart button animation.

methods.name: clearHighlights
methods.description: Clears the visual highlight from all board cells.

methods.name: highlightCell
methods.description: Highlights a specific cell to indicate a winning line.

methods.name: animateRestartButton
methods.description: Animates the restart button to emphasize game over status using alpha and color transitions.

methods.name: getColorCompat
methods.description: Retrieves color resource as an integer, used for UI theming (deprecated method).
